title: O6, then trip 2's own identifications (part 2 of 2)
description: Part 2 of 2 for O6.1, played after O6's part 1 against the same asset. Same as O6's part 2: a second trip runs and closes, then a late identification for A lands in part 1's trip window. After that, trip 2's first identification arrives for C (claimed atSec 100, inside trip 2, delivered at 270), and a later one for D (claimed atSec 120, delivered at 290). Must prove (design O6.1): trip 2's driver and the asset change to C. D's later identification changes nothing.
